title: excellent medical care
content:
Always excellent care from GPs and nurses every time I or my family have visited this practice. 
Much easier to get through by phone, now only usually 2 or 3 ahead of me in a queue, not long to wait, and receptionists have been helpful and sorted out just what I needed every time. Thank you.
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
